doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Albert's sister and politics
summary: Allen mentions Albert's sister's political activity and campaign stickers.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You know, your sister is active in politics.
Well, she has to be active in politics. Yeah. She's not too active.
She gave me some of those things you could stick on your clothes.

Yeah, I went out there, and I went to see the gold trotters. I didn't see anybody with any stickers on them, but my friend and I, we had them on. You know, I took her to the game. A little friend of mine. But nobody else had. They didn't have anything on. They didn't seem to be involved.
Yeah. But people just didn't seem to see it. Yeah, but he made it, didn't he? Yeah. He made it more. Yeah. He didn't shove it. He didn't shove it.
